verdict.rationale: Square documents a full set of building pieces for a payment flow: a Card Payments guide, the Web Payments SDK, Sandbox Payments, an interactive API Explorer, and a TypeScript SDK whose README shows copy-paste snippets for creating a client and calling payments.create. The evidence covers only one language and has no hands-on proof that a working flow can be built in under a day. Missing for 10: copy-paste examples across multiple languages, an end-to-end quickstart walkthrough, independent or hands-on corroboration of sub-day integration time.

support.subject: As a developer, I can integrate a working payment flow from the docs alone in under a day, with copy-paste examples in my language

citations.quote: The Square TypeScript library provides convenient access to the Square APIs from TypeScript.
API Explorer is an interactive web application you can use to build, view, and send HTTP requests that call Square APIs.
